canonical_claim.template: In 2025, United Wholesale Mortgage denied {value} of its 112,470 decisioned FHA applications.

required_qualifiers.population: United Wholesale Mortgage decisioned FHA applications (actions 1,2,3; loan_type 2; reverse mortgages excluded)
required_qualifiers.nature: historical institutional aggregate, unadjusted for applicant mix

does_not_establish: United Wholesale Mortgage will deny any specific future application with 21.4% probability
United Wholesale Mortgage is stricter or more lenient than another lender for a given applicant
United Wholesale Mortgage discriminates or violates law
21.4% applies to United Wholesale Mortgage's non-FHA lending
rule: Free text is the OUTPUT of evidence, not its input. Certify before you write.

proposed_use.proposed_sentence: This lender will likely reject YOUR application
